sections.heading: Anatomy — real Input Field example
paragraphs: ① Label — persistent, always paired with the field (with an optional required indicator).
② Container — holds the value/placeholder text; visual treatment set by variant (Outlined/Filled/Borderless/Inline).
③ Helper text — optional supporting or validation message below the field.

sections.heading: Variants & States
paragraphs: 60 variants total: Type(Outlined/Filled/Borderless/Inline) × Size(3) × State(Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Error). Grid below shows Type × State at Size=Md. The skill's Underlined variant and Warning/Read-only/Loading states are absent — see Flags.

sections.heading: Content Guidance (per skill)
paragraphs: Whichever container variant is chosen, the focus state must stay clearly visible — even Borderless needs a visible ring/underline on focus (confirmed above: Borderless/Focus shows the same blue ring as the other types). Validate on blur, not just at submit; clear the error the moment the value becomes valid again.

sections.heading: Do's and Don'ts
paragraphs: Show the clear icon only once the field has content; if it would collide with a suffix icon, the clear icon takes precedence while content is present. Match the mobile keyboard type to expected content. Associate error/helper text via the field's accessible description so screen readers announce it on focus, not just visually beside the field.

Gap: the skill's Variants table specifies Outlined, Filled, Underlined, Borderless. The actual build's Type axis is Outlined, Filled, Borderless, Inline — there is no Underlined variant anywhere in the 60-variant set, and Inline (visible above as the compact inline-label row) is not described anywhere in the skill at all.

Gap: the skill lists nine states (Default, Filled, Hover, Focus, Disabled, Read-only, Warning, Error, Loading). The build only implements five: Default, Hover, Focus, Disabled, Error — visible above. Error exists but Warning does not (an asymmetric gap); Read-only and Loading are absent entirely.

Possible overlap with ↳ Form: see component-form.md — a very similar single-line field control with an overlapping state vocabulary exists on a separate page under a different component family (InputControl/InputField). Not resolved here.

The skill's specialized variants (textarea, search, password, OTP, numeric/precision) have no corresponding component observed on this page — none could be confirmed built, though the Outlined/Default example above does show a leading search icon as content, not as a named variant.
